name: Mercenary Fire Breath
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Fire Breath (players/wizard/mercenary/fire_breath_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): flame speed 6 / 0.6 s (7 / 0.7 s); cooldown 0.25 s (none); no ScorchEarth. Its own mana 9, cooldown 0.25 s (0 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Fire Breath (13 magical per hit) with shorter flames, a 0.25 s cooldown, and no Scorched Earth ground.
